Heyyy bro shalom, I want to share some with you cause I don’t got no one in person to share it to or I don’t feel comfortable sharing it with anyone surrounding me cause conviction so I’m share it to you cause I know you respect and love God and I’m no better than anyone but here bro. 

Appearance vs. Substance
Appearance is having a vision your appearing, giving sight to the outward man. Appearance is outward stance, Substance isn’t necessarily drugs and such but it’s the inner man the sub-stance like a trance. If you search up trance it says half conscious so Both sides must be balanced both sides must be understood innerstood and overstood. Substance is like your essence your core values your reality/quality. As a man thinks in his heart so is he just like the law of cause and effect but there’s many perspectives and opinions so keep God in the center 

(Just notes I made today) I’m learning.

One day at a time song by- OZEKY

Violence never brings permanent peace. Father not my will but your will be done in Jesus name ⚔️ Peace Light Blessings
